title: DVC ↔ Mixxx session integration contract
purpose: Concrete integration contract showing how DVC-versioned audio stems (art_01M6V62C789085HJEBKN2AADB8 rev 1) can be pinned to a reproducible Mixxx session (art_01M6N9PCZTJSX3MA9442WEFFDX rev 3). Defines the interface boundary, assumptions, failure modes and a shell adapter script.
